Package sc.fiji.snt.gui

Record Class FileInspector.Budget

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sc.fiji.snt.gui.FileInspector.Budget
Record Components:
perPath - maximum time to wait for the inspection of a single path
total - maximum time for the whole inspection
maxPaths - maximum number of paths inspected. Others are skipped
maxDirEntries - maximum number of entries listed in a folder
maxZipBytes - zip archives larger than this are not sniffed
Enclosing class:
FileInspector
public static record FileInspector.Budget(Duration perPath, Duration total, int maxPaths, int maxDirEntries, long maxZipBytes) extends Record
Limits applied to every inspection.
